definitions.short: Achaz , the name of a Jewish king and of an Israelite
definitions.full: H271. Achaz אָחָז proper name, masculine ( he hath grasped , abbreviation for יהואחז (q. v.) compare Assyrian Ia-u-—a-zi (i.e. Ahaz) COT on 2Kin 16:8 ) 1 king of Judah, son of Jotham, father of Hezekiah 2Kin 15:38 ; 16:1-2 , 5 , 7 , 8 ; 13 t. 2Kings; Isa 1:1 ; 7:1 , 3 , 10 , 12 ; 14:28 ; 38:18 ; 1Chr 3:13 ; 2Chr 27:9 8 t. 2 Chronicles; Hosea 1:1 ; Micah 1:1 . 2 son of Micah, & great-grandson of Jonathan 1Chr 8:35-36 , 9:42 ( + 9:41 compare ᵐ5 L ᵑ9 ).

Yahweh’s* “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. word that came to Hosea the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.

Yahweh’s* “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. word that came to Micah the Morashtite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
